# Daily Report — 2026-10-16

## Task Completed
Add portal catalog request tools (sp_portal, sc_portal, sp_page tables).

New `portal_tools.py` module with six tools:
- `list_service_portals` — paginated listing of sp_portal records with title/url_suffix filters
- `get_service_portal` — retrieve a single sp_portal by sys_id or exact title
- `list_catalog_portals` — paginated listing of sc_portal (classic catalog portals)
- `get_catalog_portal` — retrieve a single sc_portal by sys_id or exact title
- `list_portal_pages` — paginated listing of sp_page records with portal_id scoping, title/page_id filters, and draft exclusion by default
- `get_portal_page` — retrieve a single sp_page by sys_id, URL id, or title; optional portal_id narrows the lookup

All six tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `tool_packages.yaml` (catalog_builder, system_administrator, and full packages).
